text:
Maya Iyer: Quick sync — can we reconcile launch posts + webinar leadflow? I noticed conversion dropped from ~6.2% to 3.1% yesterday on the campaign dashboard. Anyone else seeing this?
Chris Park: Looking at the Campaign Performance dashboard now. Impressions and clicks are steady, sessions are actually up, but the /signup step fell. Might be landing copy change. :thinking:
Ana Gomez: We did push a tiny messaging tweak in the hero on Thursday to emphasize 'self-serve' rather than 'dedicated capacity'. Could affect intent.
Evan Liu: I'll pull raw UTM streams and the webinar registration list and diff them. Which GA segment should I use — `campaign==launch_q2` or the new `launch_paid_mix` one?
Maya Iyer: Use `launch_q2` for the organic posts and `launch_paid_mix` for paid. Also check the webinar referral param `ref=webinar_march20`.
marketing-bot: Report `launch_sessions_1954` available: https://dash.redwood/campaigns/1954 - generated at 2026-03-20T09:00Z.
Chris Park: Quick sanity check: CTR on paid is up 12% but CPL doubled. Suggests lead quality shift, maybe we got more low-intent traffic.
Ana Gomez: Did we change the registration flow? I vaguely recall a smaller UX change to add an optional company size field on the modal. That could increase friction.
Evan Liu: Good call — modal change landed @deploy-bot 2026-03-19T22:10Z. I'll segment by modal vs old-flow registrations.
Maya Iyer: Action items: Evan — diff lead sources + modal flow by EOD. Chris — update dashboard widget to show conversion by landing variant (temp filter). Ana — revert copy experiment if we see worst quality. I'll summarize for the weekly KPI review. :thumbsup:
Chris Park: Done — added temporary filter, widget id `conv_by_variant_v2`. Will keep it pinned until Monday.
Ana Gomez: If quality drops, I'll roll back the hero copy and re-run the A/B test with the old headline.
Evan Liu: Preliminary pull shows 72 leads from organic social yesterday but only 18 matched marketing-qualified criteria (vs 48 historically) — sending CSV in thread.
Maya Iyer: Thanks Evan. Once you drop the CSV I’ll attach to the KPI deck for Friday's review. Can we also add a one-slide note about the modal change?
marketing-bot: File uploaded: `lead_diff_1954321000.csv` (12.4 KB)
Chris Park: Also flagging attribution window — some of paid retargeting uses a 7-day window, organic uses 30-day. That mismatch can shift how we credit webinar-sourced MQLs. Worth standardizing for this cohort.
Ana Gomez: Agreed. For the KPI review, propose we show both: current crediting and a harmonized 14-day window so stakeholders see the delta.
Maya Iyer: Love that. Evan/Chris, please include both views in the deck. I'll prep the talking points about messaging experiment and modal friction.
Evan Liu: Will do. ETA: CSV with segmented flags in 30 mins.
Maya Iyer: Great — thanks all. If we confirm rollback, can we target the revert tonight to avoid Friday traffic skew?
Ana Gomez: Yep, can flip tonight if the numbers look bad.
Chris Park: I'll monitor after revert and post a short note in #marketing when conversion normalizes.
Maya Iyer: Perfect. Meeting adjourned — will post final slide into #marketing by 16:00.
